remarks: Welcome to 9918 Du Page Ave!!!! This home possesses immense curb appeal and has been meticulously cared for by its owners for 44 years. Pulling up you will notice the extra wide driveway offers ample parking and the Huge 25 foot apron makes it easy to park 3 average cars side-by-side. You will love the raised, well-manicured front yard with a step-up walkway featuring brick ribbon steps and bullnose capping. A large, tiled entry way welcomes your guests in warmth and style. Upon entering, you will see a large, open floor plan and you will know this home is larger than most in the neighborhood as the home boasts 1,821 square feet thanks to a fully permitted family room and den.
